fact: A UNODC consultancy notice for September to December 2023 says the collection, processing, analysis and sharing of data and information in the Uganda Police is currently largely manual for lack of digital tools, that the Electronic Policing Information System (ePIS) is proposed to cover all regions, divisions, districts, stations and specialised units countrywide, and that UNODC supports the review of crime management processes under a five-year programme.
title: International Consultant to review and assess crime management business processes in the Uganda Police Force (UPF)
